description: This file defines the MapShape class, which represents a map shape within AWS SDK's API modeling system. The class manages key-value pair shapes for API data structures, including methods to retrieve key and value shapes.

classes.name: MapShape
classes.description: Represents a map shape with key and value shapes, used in AWS SDK's API modeling system. Extends the Shape class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a MapShape instance with a definition array and a ShapeMap, setting the type to 'map'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the shape of the map's values, creating it if necessary; throws an exception if not defined.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the shape of the map's keys, creating a default string shape if not specified.
